projects.title: Voting poll app
projects.description: This is a voting poll app built with React and Tailwind CSS. It allows users to create and participate in polls, view results, and share polls with others.

projects.title: Blog platform
projects.description: This is a simple blog platform built with React and Tailwind CSS. It allows users to create, edit, and delete blog posts, as well as view a list of all posts.

projects.title: E-commerce website
projects.description: This is an e-commerce website built with React and Tailwind CSS. It allows users to browse products, add items to their cart, and complete purchases.
